exposure: de novo duplication in 7p15.2 containing part of the SKAP2 gene
cohort: An 8-year-old boy with Cri du Chat syndrome.
finding: The primary finding was the identification of a de novo duplication in 7p15.2, containing part of the SKAP2 gene, in an 8-year-old boy with Cri du Chat syndrome who developed a parotid pleomorphic adenoma, suggesting a potential pathogenic role for tumor development.
